config.segmentBasis: A single segment with two revenue types: license and other (customers buying architecture and designs) and royalties (paid on every chip a customer ships). From 2026 it also sells its own chip, the Arm AGI CPU, with first commercial deliveries in FY27 Q4 (Jan–Mar 2027)
config.fiscalNote: Fiscal year ends 31 March; FY27 Q2 = Jul–Sep 2026, keyed here by calendar quarter as 2026Q3. A UK company filing quarterly shareholder letters on 6-K (US GAAP) as a foreign private issuer; its directors and officers don't file Form 4. SoftBank owns about 90%
